title.zh: 卷三百二十四 列傳第二百十二 外國五 占城 真臘 暹羅 瓜哇 三佛齊
title.en: Volume 324 Biographies 212: Foreign States 5: Champa, Khmer Empire, Siam, Java, Srivijaya
title.raw: 卷三百二十四 列傳第二百十二 外國五 占城 真臘 暹羅 瓜哇 三佛齊 Volume 324 Biographies 212: Foreign States 5: Champa, Khmer Empire, Siam, Java, Srivijaya

sentences.zh: 占城居南海中，自瓊州航海順風一晝夜可至，自福州西南行十晝夜可至，即周 越裳地。

translations.literal: Champa lies in the South Sea. From Qiongzhou, sailing with a fair wind, one can reach it in a day and night; from Fuzhou, sailing southwest, in ten days and nights. It is the land of Yuechang of the Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Champa stands in the southern seas. A fair wind from Qiongzhou brings you there in a day and night; from Fuzhou, ten days and nights sailing southwest will do the same. This was the Zhou domain of Yuechang.

sentences.zh: 秦為林邑，漢為象林縣。

translations.literal: Under the Qin it was Linyi; under the Han, Xianglin County.
translations.idiomatic: In Qin times it was Linyi; in Han times, Xianglin County.

sentences.zh: 後漢末，區連據其地，始稱林邑王。

translations.literal: At the end of Later Han, Qu Lian seized the territory and first styled himself King of Linyi.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Later Han, Qu Lian seized the region and first took the title King of Linyi.

sentences.zh: 自晉至隋仍 之。

translations.literal: From Jin through Sui it remained thus.
translations.idiomatic: From the Jin through the Sui dynasties the arrangement continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 唐時，或稱占不勞，或稱占婆，其王所居曰占城。

translations.literal: In Tang times it was sometimes called Zhanbula, sometimes Zhanpo; the place where the king dwelt was called Champa.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tang it was called either Zhanbula or Zhanpo; the king's seat was known as Champa.

sentences.zh: 至德後，改國號曰環。

translations.literal: After the Zhide reign period, the state name was changed to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhide era the state adopted the name Huan.

sentences.zh: 迄周、 宋，遂以占城為號，朝貢不替。

translations.literal: Through Zhou and Song they took Champa as the designation, and tribute missions never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Zhou and Song periods the name Champa prevailed, and tribute to the court never lapsed.

sentences.zh: 元世祖惡其阻命，大舉兵擊破之，亦不能定。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu of Yuan detested their defiance of orders and launched a great campaign to smash them, yet could not subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan founder Shizu despised their resistance to imperial command and sent a major expedition to crush them, but still could not bring them under control.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，太祖遣官以即位詔諭其國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, the Founder dispatched officials to announce his accession edict to their state.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 2, the Hongwu Emperor sent officials to convey his enthronement edict to Champa.

sentences.zh: 其王阿荅阿者先已遣使奉表來朝，貢象 虎方物。

translations.literal: Their king Archar had already sent envoys with a memorial to court, presenting elephants, tigers, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: King Archar had already sent envoys with a memorial to court, offering elephants, tigers, and regional tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，即遣官齎璽書、《大統歷》、文綺、紗羅，偕其使者往賜，其王復 遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Emperor was pleased and immediately dispatched officials bearing a seal edict, the Datong Calendar, patterned silks, and gauze, going with their envoys to bestow them; the king again sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was pleased and at once sent officials with a sealed edict, the Datong Calendar, patterned silks, and gauze, returning with their envoys to confer these gifts; the king sent tribute again in turn.

sentences.zh: 自後或比歲貢，或間歲，或一歲再貢。

translations.literal: Thereafter they sometimes offered tribute every year, sometimes every other year, sometimes twice in one year.
translations.idiomatic: After that they sometimes sent tribute annually, sometimes in alternate years, and sometimes twice in a single year.

sentences.zh: 未幾，命中書省管勾甘桓、會同 館副使路景賢齎詔，封阿荅阿者為占城國王，賜彩幣四十、《大統歷》三千。

translations.literal: Before long, he ordered Gan Huan, clerk of the Secretariat, and Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Ceremonial Reception Lu Jingxian to bear an edict, enfeoffing Archar as king of Champa, and granted forty lengths of colored silks and three thousand copies of the Datong Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he ordered Gan Huan of the Secretariat and Deputy Commissioner Lu Jingxian of the Bureau of Ceremonial Reception to carry an edict enfeoffing Archar as King of Champa, with forty lengths of colored silks and three thousand Datong Calendars as gifts.

sentences.zh: 三年 遣使往祀其山川，尋頒科舉詔於其國。

translations.literal: In the third year he dispatched envoys to sacrifice to their mountains and rivers, and soon issued the civil-service examination edict in their state.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 envoys were sent to offer sacrifice to their mountains and rivers, and shortly afterward the civil examination edict was promulgated in their country.

sentences.zh: 初，安南與占城構兵，天子遣使諭解，而安南復相侵。

translations.literal: Earlier, Annam and Champa had raised troops against each other; the Son of Heaven sent envoys to admonish them and make peace, but Annam again invaded.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Annam and Champa had gone to war; the emperor sent envoys to counsel peace, yet Annam invaded again.

sentences.zh: 四年，其王奉金葉表來 朝，長尺餘，廣五寸，刻本國字。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the king presented a memorial on a gold leaf more than a foot long and five inches wide, inscribed in their script.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 the king came to court with a memorial inscribed on a gold leaf more than a foot long and five inches wide, carved in the Champa script.

sentences.zh: 館人譯之，其意曰：「大明皇帝登大寶位，撫有 四海，如天地覆載，日月照臨。

translations.literal: The hostel interpreters translated it; its meaning was: "The Great Ming Emperor has ascended the great throne and holds the four seas in his care, as heaven and earth cover and bear all things, as sun and moon shine upon all.
translations.idiomatic: The reception-house interpreters rendered it as follows: "The Great Ming Emperor has taken the throne and cherishes the four seas, covering and sustaining all as heaven and earth do, illuminating all as the sun and moon do.

sentences.zh: 阿荅阿者譬一草木爾，欽蒙遣使，以金印封為國王， 感戴忻悅，倍萬恆情。

translations.literal: Archar is but a blade of grass or a tree, yet in reverence I received your envoys who sealed me as king with a gold seal; I am grateful and joyful beyond my usual measure of feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Archar is no more than a blade of grass, yet in awe I received your envoys, who sealed me as king with a golden seal; my gratitude and joy exceed anything I have ever known.

sentences.zh: 惟是安南用兵，侵擾疆域，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: Only Annam has taken up arms, encroaching on our borders, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Annam has taken up arms, raiding our borders and killing and plundering officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 伏願皇帝垂慈，賜以 兵器及樂器、樂人，俾安南知我占城乃聲教所被，輸貢之地，庶不敢欺陵。」

translations.literal: I humbly pray that the Emperor will show compassion and grant weapons as well as musical instruments and musicians, so that Annam may know that our Champa lies within the reach of civilizing instruction and is a land that pays tribute, and thus may not dare to bully us."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg Your Majesty's mercy: grant us weapons, musical instruments, and musicians, so that Annam may know Champa stands within the sway of your civilizing teaching and pays tribute to your court, and will not dare oppress us further."

sentences.zh: 帝命 禮部諭之曰：「占城、安南並事朝廷，同奉正朔，乃擅自構兵，毒害生靈，既失事 君之禮，又乖交鄰之道。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to instruct him, saying: "Champa and Annam both serve the court and observe the same calendar; yet you have on your own raised troops and poisoned the lives of the people—you have failed in the duty of serving your sovereign and violated the way of dealing with neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to reply: "Champa and Annam alike serve the court and observe the same calendar, yet you have taken up arms on your own and harmed the people. You have failed in loyalty to your sovereign and broken the norms of neighborly relations.

sentences.zh: 已咨安南國王，令即日罷兵。

translations.literal: I have already instructed the king of Annam to cease hostilities this very day.
translations.idiomatic: I have already instructed the king of Annam to halt his troops at once.

sentences.zh: 本國亦宜講信修睦，各保疆 土。

translations.literal: Your state too should cultivate trust and good relations and each preserve your own territory.
translations.idiomatic: Your country as well should keep faith and cultivate harmony, each guarding your own borders.

sentences.zh: 所請兵器，於王何吝，但兩國互構而賜占城，是助爾相攻，甚非撫安之義。

translations.literal: As for the weapons you request, what would the Emperor begrudge a king? Yet if both states are at war and arms are granted to Champa, that would be aiding you in mutual attack—far from the meaning of soothing and settling.
translations.idiomatic: As for the arms you request, the Emperor would not begrudge a king—but while both countries are at war, to arm Champa would be to help you strike at each other, which is hardly the way to bring peace.

sentences.zh: 樂 器、樂人，語音殊異，難以遣發。

translations.literal: As for instruments and musicians, your speech differs greatly and they would be hard to send.
translations.idiomatic: Musical instruments and musicians cannot readily be sent, for your languages differ greatly.

sentences.zh: 爾國有曉華言者，其選擇以來，當令肄習。」

translations.literal: If your state has men who understand Chinese speech, select them and send them here; they will be instructed in practice."
translations.idiomatic: If any in your country understand Chinese, choose them and send them here; we shall have them trained."

sentences.zh: 因 命福建省臣勿徵其稅，示懷柔之意。

translations.literal: He then ordered the Fujian provincial officials not to levy taxes on them, showing a policy of gentle reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the Fujian authorities not to collect taxes from them, as a sign of conciliatory regard.

sentences.zh: 六年，貢使言：「海寇張汝厚、林福等自稱元帥，剽劫海上。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the tribute envoys reported: "Sea bandits Zhang Ruhou, Lin Fu, and others styled themselves marshals and plundered on the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the tribute envoys reported: "Sea pirates Zhang Ruhou, Lin Fu, and others called themselves marshals and raided the coast.

sentences.zh: 國主擊破之，賊 魁溺死，獲其舟二十艘、蘇木七萬斤，謹奉獻。」

translations.literal: Our king defeated them; the bandit chiefs drowned, and we captured twenty of their vessels and seventy thousand jin of sappanwood, which we respectfully present."
translations.idiomatic: Our king defeated them; the ringleaders drowned, and we took twenty of their ships and seventy thousand jin of sappanwood, which we respectfully present to Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之，命給賜加等。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended this and ordered rewards of a higher grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised them and ordered enhanced gifts in return.

sentences.zh: 冬，遣使 獻安南之捷。

translations.literal: In winter he sent envoys to present news of victory over Annam.
translations.idiomatic: That winter envoys were sent to report victory over Annam.

sentences.zh: 帝謂省臣曰：「去冬，安南言占城犯境；

translations.literal: The Emperor said to the provincial officials: "Last winter Annam said Champa had violated the border;
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor told the provincial officials: "Last winter Annam claimed Champa had violated its border;

sentences.zh: 今年，占城謂安南擾邊，未 審曲直。

translations.literal: this year Champa says Annam has disturbed the border—I have not yet ascertained who is right and who is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: this year Champa says Annam has harassed its frontier. I have not yet determined which side is in the right.

sentences.zh: 可遣人往諭，各罷兵息民，毋相侵擾。」

translations.literal: You may send someone to instruct them: each side should cease troops and give the people rest, and not encroach on one another."
translations.idiomatic: Send envoys to instruct both sides to halt their armies and give the people peace, and not to raid one another."

sentences.zh: 十年與安南王陳煓大戰，煓 敗死。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he fought a great battle with the Annamese king Chen Ri; Chen Ri was defeated and died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he fought a major battle with the Annamese king Chen Ri, who was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 十二年，貢使至都，中書不以時奏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year tribute envoys reached the capital, but the Secretariat did not memorialize in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 tribute envoys reached the capital, but the Secretariat failed to report them promptly.

sentences.zh: 帝切責丞相胡惟庸、汪廣洋，二人遂獲 罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor sharply rebuked the chancellors Hu Weiyong and Wang Guangyang, and the two men were punished.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sharply rebuked Chancellors Hu Weiyong and Wang Guangyang, and both men were punished.

sentences.zh: 遣官賜王《大統歷》及衣幣，令與安南修好罷兵。

translations.literal: He dispatched officials to bestow on the king the Datong Calendar and robes and silks, ordering him to restore good relations with Annam and cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent to grant the king the Datong Calendar, robes, and silks, with orders to make peace with Annam and cease fighting.

sentences.zh: 十三年遣使賀萬壽節。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he sent envoys to congratulate the Emperor on his longevity festival.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 envoys were sent to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

sentences.zh: 帝聞其與安南水戰不利，賜敕諭曰：「曩者安南兵出， 敗於占城。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard that their naval battle with Annam had gone badly and bestowed an imperial letter of instruction, saying: "Formerly when Annam's troops went forth, they were defeated by Champa.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that their naval war with Annam had gone badly, the Emperor sent an edict: "When Annam's armies marched out before, they were beaten by Champa.

sentences.zh: 占城乘勝入安南，安南之辱已甚。

translations.literal: Champa followed up the victory and entered Annam; Annam's humiliation was already extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Champa pressed the victory and invaded Annam; Annam's humiliation was already grave enough.

sentences.zh: 王能保境息民，則福可長享；

translations.literal: If the king can preserve his borders and give the people rest, then blessings may be long enjoyed;
translations.idiomatic: If you can hold your borders and give your people peace, your blessings may endure;

sentences.zh: 如必驅 兵苦戰，勝負不可知，而鷸蚌相持，漁人得利，他日悔之，不亦晚乎？」

translations.literal: but if you must drive your troops to bitter fighting, victory and defeat cannot be known, and while snipe and clam hold each other fast the fisherman profits—will it not be too late to regret another day?"
translations.idiomatic: but if you insist on driving your armies to bitter war, the outcome is uncertain, and while snipe and clam grapple the fisherman takes the prize—will you not regret it too late when that day comes?"

sentences.zh: 十六年貢 象牙二百枝及方物。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he offered tribute of two hundred tusks of ivory and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he sent tribute of two hundred ivory tusks and regional goods.

sentences.zh: 遣官賜以勘合、文冊及織金文綺三十二、磁器萬九千。

translations.literal: The Emperor dispatched officials to grant tally slips, documents, thirty-two lengths of gold-brocaded patterned silk, and nineteen thousand pieces of porcelain.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were sent with tally documents, credentials, thirty-two lengths of gold-woven patterned silk, and nineteen thousand pieces of porcelain.

sentences.zh: 十九年 遣子寶部領詩那日忽來朝，賀萬壽節，獻象五十四，皇太子亦有獻。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he sent his son Baobuleng Shinariku to court to congratulate the longevity festival, presenting fifty-four elephants; the heir apparent also made offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he sent his son Baobuleng Shinariku to court for the birthday celebration, presenting fifty-four elephants; the crown prince made gifts as well.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其誠，賜 賚優渥，命中官送還。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended his sincerity, granted lavish rewards, and ordered a palace eunuch to escort him home.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his sincerity, gave him generous rewards, and ordered a palace eunuch to escort him home.

sentences.zh: 明年復貢象五十一及伽南、犀角諸物，帝加宴賚。

translations.literal: The next year he again offered tribute of fifty-one elephants and kyara, rhinoceros horn, and other goods; the Emperor added banquets and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he sent fifty-one more elephants plus kyara, rhinoceros horn, and other goods; the Emperor added banquets and further gifts.

sentences.zh: 還至廣東， 覆命中官宴餞，給道里費。

translations.literal: When they returned as far as Guangdong, the Emperor again ordered a palace eunuch to host a farewell banquet and provide travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On their return to Guangdong, the Emperor again ordered a palace eunuch to give them a farewell banquet and traveling expenses.

sentences.zh: 真臘貢象，占城王奪其四之一，其他失德事甚多。

translations.literal: When Chenla offered tribute elephants, the king of Champa seized a quarter of them; there were many other deeds of misconduct besides.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenla sent tribute elephants, the king of Champa seized a quarter of them, among many other acts of misconduct.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，怒。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of this, he was angry.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard of this, he was furious.

sentences.zh: 二十一年夏， 命行人董紹敕責之。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-first year he ordered the itinerant commissioner Dong Shao to rebuke him by imperial edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of year 21 he ordered Commissioner Dong Shao to deliver an edict of rebuke.

sentences.zh: 紹未至，而其貢使抵京。

translations.literal: Before Shao arrived, their tribute envoys reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Before Shao arrived, Champa's tribute envoys reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋復遣使謝罪，乃命宴賜如制。

translations.literal: Soon they again sent envoys to apologize, and he then ordered banquets and gifts according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: They soon sent envoys again to apologize, and the Emperor ordered banquets and gifts according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 時阿荅阿者失道，大臣閣勝懷不軌謀，二十三年弒王自立。

translations.literal: At this time Archar had lost the Way; the great minister Ghe Sheng harbored a treacherous design, and in the twenty-third year he assassinated the king and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: By then Archar had lost his way; the senior minister Ghe Sheng plotted treason, and in year 23 he murdered the king and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 明年遣太師奉表來 貢，帝惡其悖逆，卻之。

translations.literal: The next year he sent his grand preceptor with a memorial to offer tribute; the Emperor detested his rebellion and rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he sent his grand preceptor with a memorial and tribute, but the Emperor despised his usurpation and refused them.

sentences.zh: 三十年後，復連入貢。

translations.literal: After thirty years tribute missions again came in succession.
translations.idiomatic: After thirty years tribute missions resumed in succession.

sentences.zh: 成祖即位，詔諭其國。

translations.literal: When the Yongle Emperor ascended the throne, he issued an edict to instruct their state.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongle Emperor took the throne, he sent an edict to their country.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，其王占巴的賴奉金葉表朝貢，且告安南侵掠， 請降敕戒諭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle, their king Jaya Simhavarman presented a memorial on a gold leaf at court and reported Annam's raids and encroachments, requesting that an edict be sent down to admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1, King Jaya Simhavarman came to court with a gold-leaf memorial, reporting Annam's raids and asking that an edict be sent to restrain them.

sentences.zh: 帝可之，遣行人蔣賓興、王樞使其國，賜以絨、錦、織金文綺、紗羅。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved and dispatched the itinerant commissioners Jiang Binxing and Wang Shu as envoys to their state, bestowing velvet, brocade, gold-woven patterned silk, and gauze.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and sent Commissioners Jiang Binxing and Wang Shu to their country with gifts of velvet, brocade, gold-woven silk, and gauze.

sentences.zh: 明年，以安南王胡牴奏，詔戢兵，遣官諭占城王。

translations.literal: The next year, on the memorial of the Annamese king Hu Di, an edict ordered the cessation of troops, and officials were sent to instruct the king of Champa.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, on a memorial from the Annamese king Hu Di, an edict ordered both sides to cease fighting, and officials were sent to instruct the king of Champa.

sentences.zh: 而王遣使奏：「安南不遵詔旨， 以舟師來侵，朝貢人回，賜物悉遭奪掠。

translations.literal: But the king sent envoys to memorialize: "Annam does not obey the edict and has come with a fleet to invade; when our tribute envoys returned, all the gifts they had been granted were seized and plundered.
translations.idiomatic: But the king sent envoys reporting: "Annam has ignored the edict and sent a fleet to invade us; when our tribute envoys returned, everything Your Majesty had granted them was seized.

sentences.zh: 又畀臣冠服、印章，俾為臣屬。

translations.literal: They also gave me robes and a seal, making me their subject.
translations.idiomatic: They also gave me robes and a seal, treating me as their vassal.

sentences.zh: 且已據臣 沙離牙諸地，更侵掠未已，臣恐不能自存。

translations.literal: Moreover they have already occupied my territories of Shalijia and others, and their raids and encroachments have not ceased; I fear I cannot preserve myself.
translations.idiomatic: They have already seized my territories around Shalijia and continue to raid without end; I fear I cannot survive.

sentences.zh: 乞隸版圖，遣官往治。」

translations.literal: I beg to be placed within the imperial domain and that officials be sent to govern."
translations.idiomatic: I beg to be brought under the imperial domain and that officials be sent to govern us."

sentences.zh: 帝怒，敕責胡 牴，而賜占城王鈔幣。

translations.literal: The Emperor was angry, sent an edict rebuking Hu Di, and granted the king of Champa paper money and silks.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was enraged, sent an edict rebuking Hu Di, and rewarded the king of Champa with paper money and silks.

sentences.zh: 四年貢白象方物，復告安南之難。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he offered tribute of a white elephant and local products, again reporting Annam's aggression.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he sent tribute of a white elephant and regional goods, again reporting distress from Annam.

sentences.zh: 帝大發兵往討，敕占城嚴兵境上，遏其越逸， 獲者即送京師。

translations.literal: The Emperor launched a major campaign to punish them and ordered Champa to mass troops on the border, block any who fled across, and send captives at once to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent a major expedition against Annam and ordered Champa to mass troops on the frontier, block fugitives from crossing, and send any captives straight to the capital.

sentences.zh: 五年攻取安南所侵地，獲賊黨胡烈、潘麻休等獻俘闕下，貢方物謝 恩。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he attacked and recovered the lands Annam had seized, captured the rebel partisans Hu Lie and Pan Maxiu, and presented captives at the palace gate, sending local products in thanks for imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he recovered the lands Annam had seized, captured rebels including Hu Lie and Pan Maxiu, and presented prisoners at court, sending regional goods in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其助兵討逆，遣中官王貴通齎敕及銀幣賜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended his aid in raising troops to suppress rebels and dispatched the palace eunuch Wang Guitong to bear an edict and silver and silks as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised his help in the campaign against the rebels and sent the eunuch Wang Guitong with an edict and gifts of silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 六年，鄭和使其國。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Zheng He was sent as envoy to their state.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 Zheng He was dispatched to their country.

sentences.zh: 王遣其孫舍楊該貢象及方物謝恩。

translations.literal: The king sent his grandson Sheyangai with tribute elephants and local products to express thanks for imperial grace.
translations.idiomatic: The king sent his grandson Sheyangai with elephants and regional goods to express gratitude.

sentences.zh: 十年，其貢使乞冠帶， 予之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year their tribute envoys requested caps and belts, and these were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 their tribute envoys asked for official caps and belts, and these were granted.

sentences.zh: 覆命鄭和使其國。

translations.literal: Again Zheng He was ordered as envoy to their state.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng He was again dispatched to their country.

sentences.zh: 十三年，王師方征陳季擴，命占城助兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the imperial army was campaigning against Chen Jikuai, and Champa was ordered to assist with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13, while the imperial army was campaigning against Chen Jikuai, Champa was ordered to send troops to assist.

sentences.zh: 尚書陳洽言：「其王陰懷二心，愆期 不進，反以金帛、戰象資季擴，季擴以黎蒼女遺之。

translations.literal: Minister Chen Qia said: "Their king secretly harbored divided loyalties, missed the deadline and did not advance, but instead supplied Chen Jikuai with gold, silks, and war elephants; Chen Jikuai gave him a daughter of Li Cang in return.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Chen Qia reported: "Their king secretly wavered in loyalty, failed to advance on schedule, and instead supplied Chen Jikuai with gold, silks, and war elephants; Chen Jikuai gave him a daughter of Li Cang in return.

sentences.zh: 復約季擴舅陳翁挺侵昇華府所 轄四州十一縣地。

translations.literal: He also agreed with Chen Jikuai's uncle Chen Wengting to invade the four prefectures and eleven counties under the jurisdiction of Shenghua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He also agreed with Chen Jikuai's uncle Chen Wengting to invade the four prefectures and eleven counties under Shenghua.

sentences.zh: 厥罪維均，宜遣兵致討。」

translations.literal: His guilt is equal; troops should be sent to punish him."
translations.idiomatic: His guilt is equal to Chen Jikuai's; troops should be sent against him."

sentences.zh: 帝以交址初平，不欲勞師，但賜敕切 責，俾還侵地，王即遣使謝罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Jiaozhi had only just been pacified and he did not wish to weary the army, merely bestowed a stern edict ordering the return of seized lands; the king at once sent envoys to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, since Jiaozhi had only just been pacified and he did not wish to burden the army further, sent only a stern edict demanding the return of seized territory; the king immediately sent envoys to apologize.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遣其孫舍那挫來朝。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he sent his grandson Shenacuo to court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he sent his grandson Shenacuo to court.

sentences.zh: 命中官林貴、行人倪 俊送歸，有賜。

translations.literal: He ordered the palace eunuch Lin Gui and the itinerant commissioner Ni Jun to escort him home, with gifts.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the eunuch Lin Gui and Commissioner Ni Jun to escort him home with gifts.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，行人黃原昌往頒正朔，繩其王不恪，卻所酬金幣以歸，擢戶部員外 郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, the itinerant commissioner Huang Yuanchang went to announce the calendar; he held the king accountable for lack of reverence, refused the gold and silks offered in reward, and returned home; he was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1, Commissioner Huang Yuanchang went to announce the calendar; he censured the king for disrespect, refused the gold and silks offered him, and returned; he was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，瓊州知府程瑩言：「占城比年一貢，勞費實多。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong, the prefect of Qiongzhou, Cheng Ying, said: "Champa has offered tribute every year in recent times, and the labor and expense are truly great.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 1, Qiongzhou Prefect Cheng Ying said: "Champa has sent tribute annually in recent years, and the cost in labor and expense is considerable.

sentences.zh: 乞如暹羅諸國例， 三年一貢。」

translations.literal: I beg that it follow the precedent of Siam and other states—tribute once every three years."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that it follow the precedent of Siam and the other states and send tribute once every three years."

sentences.zh: 帝是之，敕其使如瑩言，賜王及妃彩幣。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved and instructed their envoys according to Cheng Ying's proposal, granting colored silks to the king and queen.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed and instructed their envoys accordingly, granting colored silks to the king and queen.

sentences.zh: 然番人利中國市易，雖有此 令，迄不遵。

translations.literal: Yet the foreigners profited from trade with China, and though this order existed, they never obeyed it to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the foreigners profited from trade with China, and despite the order they never complied.

sentences.zh: 六年，王占巴的賴卒，其孫摩訶賁該以遺命遣王孫述提昆來朝貢，且乞嗣位。

translations.literal: In the sixth year King Jaya Simhavarman died; his grandson Mahapandita, by the late king's testament, sent the royal grandson Shatiguna to court with tribute and to request succession to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 King Jaya Simhavarman died; his grandson Mahapandita, acting on the late king's testament, sent the royal grandson Shatiguna to court with tribute to request the succession.

sentences.zh: 乃遣給事中管曈、行人吳惠齎詔，封為王，新王及妃並有賜。

translations.literal: The court then dispatched the supervising secretary Guan Tan and the itinerant commissioner Wu Hui to bear an edict enfeoffing him as king; the new king and queen both received gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Supervising Secretary Guan Tan and Commissioner Wu Hui with an edict to enfeoff him as king; the new king and queen both received gifts.

sentences.zh: 七年春，述提昆卒於 途，帝憫之，遣官賜祭。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year Shatiguna died on the journey; the Emperor pitied him and dispatched officials to grant sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 7 Shatiguna died en route; the Emperor took pity and sent officials to perform sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 八年遣從子且揚樂催貢舞牌旗黑象。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he sent his nephew Qieyang Le to urge tribute of dance placards, banners, and a black elephant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he sent his nephew Qieyang Le to present dance placards, banners, and a black elephant as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年，敕諭摩訶賁該曰：「邇者，安南王黎浚遣使奏王欺其孤幼，曩已侵升、 華、思、義四州，今又屢攻化州，掠其人畜財物。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict instructed Mahapandita, saying: "Recently the king of Annam, Li Jun, sent envoys to memorialize that you have bullied him while he is young and orphaned; you have already encroached on the four prefectures of Sheng, Hua, Si, and Yi, and now you have repeatedly attacked Huazhou, plundering its people, livestock, and goods.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 an edict addressed Mahapandita: "Recently the king of Annam, Li Jun, reported that you have bullied him in his youth and orphanhood; you have already seized the four prefectures of Sheng, Hua, Si, and Yi, and now you repeatedly attack Huazhou, plundering its people, livestock, and goods.

sentences.zh: 二國俱受朝命，各有分疆，豈可 興兵構怨，乖睦鄰保境之義。

translations.literal: Both states have received commands from the court and each has its allotted territory—how can you raise troops and breed enmity, violating the principle of friendly relations with neighbors and preserving borders?
translations.idiomatic: Both countries hold commissions from the court and each has its own borders—how can you raise troops and breed hatred, violating the duty of neighborly harmony and guarding your frontiers?

sentences.zh: 王宜祗循禮分，嚴飭邊臣，毋恣肆侵軼，貽禍生靈。」

translations.literal: The king should reverently observe ritual propriety, strictly admonish his border officials, and not wantonly encroach and raid, bringing calamity upon the living."
translations.idiomatic: You should respectfully observe your proper station, strictly restrain your border officials, and not raid at will, bringing disaster upon the people."

sentences.zh: 並諭安南嚴行備御，毋挾私報復。

translations.literal: Annam was also instructed to maintain strict defenses and not take private revenge.
translations.idiomatic: Annam was also instructed to maintain strict defenses and not seek private revenge.

sentences.zh: 先是，定三年一貢之例，其國不遵。

translations.literal: Earlier the precedent of tribute once every three years had been fixed, but their state did not obey it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the three-year tribute interval had been established, but Champa did not observe it.

sentences.zh: 及詰其使者， 則云：「先王已逝，前敕無存，故不知此令。」

translations.literal: When their envoys were questioned, they said: "The former king has passed away and the earlier edict no longer exists, so we did not know this order."
translations.idiomatic: When their envoys were questioned, they said: "The former king has died and the earlier edict no longer survives, so we did not know of this rule."

sentences.zh: 是歲，貢使復至，再敕王遵制，賜 王及妃彩幣。

translations.literal: That year tribute envoys came again; the king was again instructed to obey the regulation, and colored silks were granted to the king and queen.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute envoys came again; the king was again ordered to observe the regulation, and colored silks were granted to the king and queen.

sentences.zh: 冬復遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In winter envoys were again sent to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter envoys were sent again with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年，王與安南戰，大敗被執。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the king fought Annam, suffered a great defeat, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 the king fought Annam, was utterly defeated, and taken captive.

sentences.zh: 故王占巴的賴侄摩訶貴來遣使奏：「先王抱 疾，曾以臣為世子，欲令嗣位。

translations.literal: The former king Jaya Simhavarman's nephew Mahakshatriya sent envoys to memorialize: "When the late king was ill he had named me heir apparent, intending that I succeed to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The late King Jaya Simhavarman's nephew Mahakshatriya sent envoys reporting: "When the late king fell ill he named me heir apparent, intending that I succeed him.

sentences.zh: 臣時年幼，遜位於舅氏摩訶賁該。

translations.literal: At that time I was young and yielded the throne to my maternal uncle Mahapandita.
translations.idiomatic: I was still young then and yielded the throne to my maternal uncle Mahapandita.

sentences.zh: 後屢興兵伐安南， 致敵兵入舊州古壘等處，殺掠人畜殆盡，王亦被擒。

translations.literal: Later he repeatedly raised troops to attack Annam, causing enemy troops to enter Jiuzhou, Gulei, and other places; people and livestock were killed and plundered almost to exhaustion, and the king was also captured.
translations.idiomatic: Later he repeatedly marched against Annam until enemy forces entered Jiuzhou, Gulei, and other districts, slaughtering and plundering people and livestock nearly to extinction; the king too was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 國人以臣先王之侄，且有遺命， 請臣代位。

translations.literal: The people of the state, because I was the late king's nephew and there was also a dying command, requested that I take the throne in his place.
translations.idiomatic: The people asked me to take the throne, for I was the late king's nephew and there was a testament naming me.

sentences.zh: 辭之再三，不得已始於府前治事。

translations.literal: I declined again and again; only when there was no alternative did I begin to conduct affairs before the palace.
translations.idiomatic: I refused again and again, and only when there was no choice did I begin to govern from before the palace.

sentences.zh: 臣不敢自專，伏候朝命。」

translations.literal: I dare not act on my own authority; I bow and await the court's command."
translations.idiomatic: I dare not decide alone and humbly await the court's order."

sentences.zh: 乃遣給事 中陳誼、行人薛干封為王，諭以保國交鄰，並諭國中臣民共相輔翼。

translations.literal: The court then sent Supervising Secretary Chen Yi and Commissioner Xue Ganfeng to invest him as king, instructing him to preserve the state and maintain good relations with neighbors, and also instructing the officials and people of the state to assist one another.
translations.idiomatic: The court then dispatched Supervising Secretary Chen Yi and Commissioner Xue Ganfeng to invest him as king, enjoining him to safeguard the realm and live in friendship with his neighbors, and directing the kingdom's officials and people to support one another.

sentences.zh: 十三年敕安南 送摩訶賁該還國，不奉命。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year an edict ordered Annam to send Mahapandita back to his country; it did not obey the command.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 an edict ordered Annam to return Mahapandita to his country; Annam disobeyed.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年遣使來貢，且告王訃。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingtai envoys were sent to offer tribute and also to announce the king's death.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai year 3 envoys came with tribute and reported the king's death.

sentences.zh: 命給事中潘本愚、行人邊永封其弟摩訶貴由為 王。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Pan Benyu and Commissioner Bian Yong were ordered to invest his younger brother Mahakshatriya as king.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Pan Benyu and Commissioner Bian Yong were sent to invest his younger brother Mahakshatriya as king.

sentences.zh: 天順元年入貢，賜其正副使钑花金帶。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun they entered with tribute; the chief and deputy envoys were granted gold belts with damascened floral patterns.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 they presented tribute; the chief and deputy envoys were given gold belts with floral damascene.

sentences.zh: 二年，王摩訶槃羅悅新立，遣使奉表朝 貢。

translations.literal: In the second year King Mahabandhula was newly established and sent envoys bearing a memorial to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 the newly enthroned King Mahabandhula sent envoys with a memorial and tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年復貢，自正使以下賜紗帽及金銀角帶有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year they offered tribute again; from the chief envoy downward, gauze caps and gold and silver corner-belts were granted in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 they sent tribute again; from the chief envoy down, gauze caps and gold or silver corner-belts were awarded by rank.

sentences.zh: 使者訴安南見侵，因敕諭安南 王。

translations.literal: The envoys complained that Annam was encroaching upon them; accordingly an edict was sent to admonish the king of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys reported Annam's encroachments, and the court issued an edict admonishing the king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 九月，使來，告王喪。

translations.literal: In the ninth month envoys came and announced the king's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month envoys arrived announcing the king's death.

sentences.zh: 命給事中黃汝霖、行人劉恕封王弟槃羅茶全為王。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Huang Rulin and Commissioner Liu Shu were ordered to invest the king's younger brother Bhadravarman as king.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Huang Rulin and Commissioner Liu Shu were dispatched to invest the king's brother Bhadravarman as king.

sentences.zh: 八年入貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth year they entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 they presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 憲宗嗣位，應頒賜蕃國錦幣，禮官請付使臣齎回，從之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xianzong succeeded to the throne, brocades and silks that should be granted to foreign states were due; the ritual officials requested that they be given to the envoys to carry back, and the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xianzong ascended the throne, the customary grants of brocade and silk to tributary states came due; the Ministry of Rites asked that they be entrusted to the envoys for the return journey, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 使者復訴 安南見侵，求索白象。

translations.literal: The envoys again complained that Annam was encroaching and was demanding white elephants.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys again reported Annam's incursions and its demands for white elephants.

sentences.zh: 乞如永樂時，遣官安撫，建立界牌石，以杜侵陵。

translations.literal: They begged that, as in the Yongle era, officials be dispatched to reassure them and boundary marker stones erected, so as to stop encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that, as in the Yongle reign, officials be sent to reassure them and boundary stones set up to check further encroachment.

sentences.zh: 兵部以兩 國方爭，不便遣使，乞令使臣歸諭國王，務循禮法，固封疆，捍外侮，毋輕構禍， 從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War argued that because the two states were just then at odds, it was inconvenient to dispatch envoys; it requested that the envoys be sent home to instruct the king to observe ritual and law strictly, secure the borders, repel external aggression, and not lightly stir up disaster—and the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War noted that the two countries were then at odds and dispatching envoys would be unwise; it proposed sending the envoys home to tell the king to observe proper conduct, hold the borders firm, resist outside aggression, and not rashly invite disaster. The proposal was accepted.

sentences.zh: 成化五年入貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chenghua they entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 5 they sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 時安南索占城犀象、寶貨，令以事天朝之禮事之。

translations.literal: At the time Annam demanded from Champa rhinoceros horn, elephants, and precious goods, and required that Champa treat Annam with the same ceremony owed the Heavenly Court.
translations.idiomatic: Annam was then demanding rhinoceros horn, elephants, and other treasures from Champa and insisting that Champa treat Annam with the same deference owed the court.

sentences.zh: 占城不從， 大舉往伐。

translations.literal: Champa did not comply and raised a great force to attack in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Champa refused and marched against Annam in force.

sentences.zh: 七年破其國，執王槃羅茶全及家屬五十餘人，劫印符，大肆焚掠，遂據 其地。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Annam broke their state, seized King Bhadravarman and more than fifty members of his household, stole the seals and credentials, burned and plundered on a great scale, and then occupied their territory.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Annam overran the kingdom, seized King Bhadravarman and more than fifty of his kin, stole the seals of office, burned and looted widely, and occupied the land.

sentences.zh: 王弟槃羅茶悅逃山中，遣使告難。

translations.literal: The king's younger brother Panlo Chayue fled into the mountains and sent envoys to report the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The king's brother Panlo Chayue fled into the hills and sent envoys pleading for help.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「安南吞併與國，若不為處分， 非惟失占城歸附之心，抑恐啟安南跋扈之志。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "Annam has swallowed a friendly state; if no measures are taken, not only will Champa's will to submit be lost, but Annam's arrogant ambitions may also be encouraged.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War argued: "Annam has annexed an allied kingdom. If nothing is done, we will lose Champa's loyalty—and risk encouraging Annam's arrogance.

sentences.zh: 宜遣官齎敕宣諭，還其國王及眷屬。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to dispatch officials bearing an edict to proclaim the command and restore their king and his dependents."
translations.idiomatic: Officials should be sent with an edict ordering the return of the king and his family."

sentences.zh: 帝慮安逆命，令俟貢使至日，賜敕責之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, fearing that Annam would defy the command, ordered that when its tribute envoys arrived, an edict rebuking it be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, fearing defiance from Annam, ordered that when its tribute envoys arrived an edict of rebuke be delivered.

sentences.zh: 八年，以槃羅茶悅請封，命給事中陳峻、行人李珊持節往。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Panlo Chayue requested investiture, Supervising Secretary Chen Jun and Commissioner Li Shan were ordered to go bearing credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, at Panlo Chayue's request for investiture, Supervising Secretary Chen Jun and Commissioner Li Shan were sent with full credentials.

sentences.zh: 峻等至新州港，守 者拒之，知其國已為安南所據，改為交南州，乃不敢入。

translations.literal: When Chen Jun and the others reached Xinzhou Harbor, the guards refused them entry; learning that the country had already been seized by Annam and renamed Jiaonan Prefecture, they dared not enter.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jun's party reached Xinzhou Harbor but the guards turned them away; learning that Annam had seized the country and renamed it Jiaonan Prefecture, they did not dare enter.

sentences.zh: 十年冬還朝。

translations.literal: In the winter of the tenth year they returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: They returned to court in the winter of year 10.

sentences.zh: 安南既破占城，復遣兵執槃羅茶悅，立前王孫齋亞麻弗菴為王，以國南邊地予 之。

translations.literal: After Annam had destroyed Champa, it again sent troops to seize Panlo Chayue, installed the former king's grandson Jayavarman as king, and gave him the southern borderlands of the state.
translations.idiomatic: After destroying Champa, Annam sent troops again to seize Panlo Chayue, installed the former king's grandson Jayavarman as ruler, and allotted him the kingdom's southern marches.

sentences.zh: 十四年，遣使朝貢請封，命給事中馮義、行人張瑾往封之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year envoys were sent to court with tribute requesting investiture; Supervising Secretary Feng Yi and Commissioner Zhang Jin were ordered to go and invest him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 envoys came to court seeking investiture; Supervising Secretary Feng Yi and Commissioner Zhang Jin were sent to perform the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 義等多攜私物，既 至廣東，聞齋亞麻弗菴已死，其弟古來遣使乞封。

translations.literal: Feng Yi and the others took much private merchandise with them; when they reached Guangdong they heard that Jayavarman had already died and that his younger brother Kulai had sent envoys begging investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yi and his party carried much private cargo; reaching Guangdong they learned Jayavarman was dead and his brother Kulai had sent envoys requesting investiture.

sentences.zh: 義等慮空還失利，亟至占城。

translations.literal: Feng Yi and the others, fearing that returning empty-handed would mean lost profit, hurried on to Champa.
translations.idiomatic: Fearful of returning with nothing to show, Feng Yi's party pressed on to Champa.

sentences.zh: 占 城人言，王孫請封之後，即為古來所殺，安南以偽敕立其國人提婆苔為王。

translations.literal: The people of Champa said that after the king's grandson had requested investiture he was immediately killed by Kulai, and Annam, with a forged edict, installed one of their countrymen, Deva Bat, as king.
translations.idiomatic: Champa reported that the prince who had sought investiture was killed by Kulai soon after; Annam then used a forged edict to install a local man, Deva Bat, as king.

sentences.zh: 義等不 俟奏報，輒以印幣授提婆苔封之，得所賂黃金百餘兩，又往滿剌加國盡貨其私物以 歸。

translations.literal: Feng Yi and the others, without waiting for a memorial and reply from the throne, promptly granted the seals and investiture regalia to Deva Bat and invested him; they received more than a hundred taels of gold in bribes and then went to Malacca to sell off all their private goods before returning.
translations.idiomatic: Without awaiting imperial approval, Feng Yi invested Deva Bat with the seals and regalia, took more than a hundred taels of gold in bribes, stopped in Malacca to sell their private goods, and returned home.

sentences.zh: 義至海洋病死。

translations.literal: Feng Yi died of illness on the ocean.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yi died of illness at sea.

sentences.zh: 瑾具其事，並上偽敕於朝。

translations.literal: Zhang Jin set forth the whole affair and also presented the forged edict to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jin reported the whole affair to court and submitted the forged edict.

sentences.zh: 十七年，古來遣使朝貢，言：「安南破臣國時，故王弟槃羅茶悅逃居佛靈山。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Kulai sent envoys to court with tribute, saying: "When Annam destroyed my state, the late king's brother Panlo Chayue fled and took refuge on Mount Foling.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Kulai sent tribute envoys who reported: "When Annam destroyed our kingdom, the late king's brother Panlo Chayue fled to Mount Foling.

sentences.zh: 比天使齎封誥至，已為賊人執去，臣與兄齋亞麻弗菴潛竄山谷。

translations.literal: By the time the heavenly envoy arrived bearing the patent of investiture, he had already been seized by the bandits; my brother Jayavarman and I secretly hid ourselves in mountain valleys.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the imperial envoy arrived with the investiture patent, bandits had already seized him; my brother Jayavarman and I hid in the mountains.

sentences.zh: 後賊人畏懼天威， 遣人訪覓臣兄，還以故地。

translations.literal: Later the bandits, fearing the heavenly majesty, sent men to seek out my brother and restored our former territory to him.
translations.idiomatic: Later, fearing the court's wrath, the invaders searched out my brother and returned our old lands to him.

sentences.zh: 然自邦都郎至占臘止五處，臣兄權國未幾，遽爾隕歿。

translations.literal: Yet from Bang Du Lang to Zhanla there were only five places; my brother ruled in his own right only briefly before he suddenly died.
translations.idiomatic: But from Bang Du Lang to Zhanla we held only five districts; my brother had ruled only briefly when he suddenly died.

sentences.zh: 臣當嗣立，不敢自專，仰望天恩，賜之冊印。

translations.literal: I ought to succeed and take the throne, but I dare not decide on my own; I look up to heavenly grace and beg that registers and seals be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The succession should fall to me, but I dare not act alone; I look to the Emperor's grace for investiture with patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 臣國所有土地本二十七處，四府、一 州、二十二縣。

translations.literal: Our state's lands originally numbered twenty-seven places: four prefectures, one zhou, and twenty-two counties.
translations.idiomatic: Our kingdom once comprised twenty-seven districts—four prefectures, one zhou, and twenty-two counties.

sentences.zh: 東至海，南至占臘，西至黎人山，北至阿本喇補，凡三千五百餘里。

translations.literal: East to the sea, south to Zhanla, west to Liren Mountain, north to Aben Labu—in all more than three thousand five hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It stretched east to the sea, south to Zhanla, west to Liren Mountain, and north to Aben Labu—more than three thousand five hundred li in all.

sentences.zh: 乞特諭交人，盡還本國。」

translations.literal: I beg that Annam be specially instructed to restore all of our native territory."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the Annamese be expressly ordered to return all our lands."

sentences.zh: 章下廷議，英國公張懋等請特遣近臣有威望者二人往使。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down for court deliberation; the Duke of Ying, Zhang Mao, and others requested that two close ministers of standing be specially dispatched as envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial went to court for deliberation; the Duke of Ying, Zhang Mao, and others proposed dispatching two senior ministers of standing as special envoys.

sentences.zh: 時安南貢使方歸，即賜敕詰責黎灝，令速還地，毋抗朝命。

translations.literal: At the time Annam's tribute envoys were just returning; an edict was immediately granted rebuking Li Hao and ordering the swift return of the territory and no defiance of the court's command.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's tribute envoys were just leaving; the court at once issued an edict rebuking Li Hao and ordering the immediate return of the seized lands, with a warning against defying the throne.

sentences.zh: 禮官乃劾瑾擅封，執下 詔獄，具得其情，論死。

translations.literal: The ritual officials then impeached Zhang Jin for unauthorized investiture, had him arrested and imprisoned in the edict prison; the full facts were obtained, and death was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites impeached Zhang Jin for unauthorized investiture; he was arrested and jailed in the edict prison, the facts were fully established, and death was recommended.

sentences.zh: 時古來所遣使臣在館，召問之，云：「古來實王弟，其王 病死，非弒。

translations.literal: At the time Kulai's envoys were lodged in the embassy quarters; they were summoned and questioned, and said: "Kulai is indeed the king's younger brother; the king died of illness—it was not murder.
translations.idiomatic: Kulai's envoys were still lodged in the capital; questioned, they said: "Kulai is truly the king's brother; the king died of illness, not by assassination.

sentences.zh: 提婆苔不知何人。」

translations.literal: As for Deva Bat, no one knows who he is."
translations.idiomatic: No one knows who Deva Bat is."

sentences.zh: 乃命使臣暫歸廣東，俟提婆苔使至，審誠偽處之。

translations.literal: They were then ordered to return temporarily to Guangdong and wait until Deva Bat's envoys arrived, when truth and falsehood would be examined and dealt with accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys were told to wait in Guangdong until Deva Bat's representatives arrived, when their claims would be investigated.

sentences.zh: 使臣候命經年，提婆苔使者不至，乃令還國。

translations.literal: The envoys waited for orders for more than a year; Deva Bat's envoys did not come, and they were then ordered to return to their country.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys waited more than a year; when Deva Bat's representatives never came, they were sent home.

sentences.zh: 二十年敕古來撫諭提婆苔，使納原降國王印，宥其受偽封之罪，仍為頭目。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year an edict ordered Kulai to reassure and instruct Deva Bat to surrender the seal of the originally submitted king, pardon his crime of accepting a false investiture, and remain as a subordinate chief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 an edict ordered Kulai to reassure Deva Bat, require him to surrender the seal of the originally submitted king, pardon his acceptance of a false investiture, and retain him as a subordinate chief.

sentences.zh: 提婆苔不受命，乃遣給事中李孟暘、行人葉應冊封古來為國王。

translations.literal: Deva Bat did not accept the order, so Supervising Secretary Li Mengyang and Attendant Ye Ying were sent to invest Kulai as king.
translations.idiomatic: Deva Bat refused, so Supervising Secretary Li Mengyang and Attendant Ye Ying were sent to invest Kulai as king.

sentences.zh: 孟暘等言：「占城險遠，安南構兵未已，提婆苔又竊據其地，稍或不慎，反損國威。

translations.literal: Mengyang and the others said: "Champa is perilous and remote, Annam is still raising troops, and Deva Bat also holds the land by stealth; if we are not careful, national prestige will instead be harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang and his colleagues said: "Champa is remote and dangerous, Annam is still at war, and Deva Bat also holds part of the country. One misstep could damage imperial prestige.

sentences.zh: 宜令來使傳諭古來，詣廣東受封，並敕安南悔禍。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to have the arriving envoys convey instructions to Kulai to go to Guangdong to receive investiture, and also to order Annam to repent its calamity."
translations.idiomatic: The envoys should instruct Kulai to receive investiture in Guangdong, and Annam should be ordered to repent."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 古來乃自老撾挈家赴崖州，孟暘竣封事而返。

translations.literal: Kulai then brought his family from Laos to Yazhou, and Mengyang completed the investiture and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Kulai then brought his family from Laos to Yazhou, and Mengyang completed the investiture and returned.

sentences.zh: 古來又欲躬詣闕廷，奏安南之罪。

translations.literal: Kulai also wished to go in person to the imperial court and present Annam's crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Kulai also wished to go in person to court and accuse Annam.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，總督宋旻以聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Governor-General Song Min reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 Governor-General Song Min reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 廷議遣大臣一人往勞，檄安南存亡繼絕，迎古來返占城。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on sending a senior minister to console him, issue a summons to Annam under the principle of preserving fallen states and continuing severed lines, and escort Kulai back to Champa.
translations.idiomatic: The court decided to send a senior minister to console Kulai, summon Annam under the duty to restore fallen states, and escort him back to Champa.

sentences.zh: 帝報可，命南京右都御史屠滽往。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved and ordered Right Censor-in-Chief of Nanjing Tu Fu to go.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved and ordered Nanjing Right Censor-in-Chief Tu Fu to go.

sentences.zh: 至廣東，即傳檄安南，宣示禍福。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Guangdong, he at once transmitted a summons to Annam, declaring the consequences of fortune and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Guangdong, he immediately sent a summons to Annam setting out the consequences.

sentences.zh: 募健卒二千人，駕海舟二十艘，護古來還國。

translations.literal: He recruited two thousand sturdy soldiers, manned twenty seagoing vessels, and escorted Kulai back to his country.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited two thousand soldiers, manned twenty seagoing vessels, and escorted Kulai home.

sentences.zh: 安南以滽大臣奉特遣，不敢抗，古來乃得入。

translations.literal: Annam, seeing that Tu was a minister sent on special commission, did not dare resist, and Kulai was able to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Annam, seeing that Tu had been specially dispatched as a senior minister, did not dare resist, and Kulai was able to return.

sentences.zh: 明年，弘治改元，遣使入貢。

translations.literal: The next year, when Hongzhi began its reign period, envoys were sent to enter with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, with the new Hongzhi reign, envoys came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年遣弟卜古良赴廣東，言：「安南仍肆侵陵， 乞如永樂時遣將督兵守護。」

translations.literal: In the second year Kulai sent his younger brother Buguliang to Guangdong, saying: "Annam is still wantonly encroaching; I beg that generals be dispatched as in the Yongle era to command troops in our defense."
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 he sent his brother Buguliang to Guangdong with a plea: "Annam still encroaches at will; send generals with troops to guard us, as in the Yongle reign."

sentences.zh: 總督秦紘等以聞。

translations.literal: Governor-General Qin Hong and others reported this to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Qin Hong reported the petition to court.

sentences.zh: 兵部言：「安南、占城皆《祖訓》 所載不征之國。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War said: "Annam and Champa are both among the states recorded in the Ancestral Admonitions as not to be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War replied: "Annam and Champa are both listed in the 'Ancestral Admonitions' as countries the dynasty must not attack.

sentences.zh: 永樂間命將出師，乃正黎賊弒逆之罪，非以鄰境交惡之故。

translations.literal: When troops were ordered out in the Yongle reign, it was to punish the Li usurper's crime of regicide, not because of border quarrels between neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongle campaign was to punish the Li regicides—not to settle border disputes between neighbors.

sentences.zh: 今黎灝 修貢惟謹，古來膚受之醞，容有過情，不可信其單詞，勞師不征之國。

translations.literal: Now Li Hao presents tribute with utmost care; Kulai's grievances absorbed at face value may be excessive; his lone testimony cannot be trusted to mobilize troops against a state the dynasty must not attack.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hao now sends tribute with scrupulous care; Kulai's complaints, taken at face value, may be exaggerated. We cannot trust a single petition and mobilize against a country the ancestors forbade us to attack.

sentences.zh: 宜令守臣回 咨，言近交人殺害王子古蘇麻，王即率眾敗之，仇恥已雪。

translations.literal: The frontier officials should be ordered to reply, saying that recently the Annamese killed the prince Gu Sumar, and the king immediately led his forces to defeat them; vengeance and shame have already been wiped away.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials should reply that the Annamese recently killed Prince Gu Sumar, that the king rallied his forces and defeated them, and that the score is already settled.

sentences.zh: 王宜自強修政，撫飖國 人，保固疆圉，仍與安南惇睦修好。

translations.literal: The king should strengthen himself and improve government, soothe the people of the state, secure and hold the borders, and still live in sincere friendship and good relations with Annam.
translations.idiomatic: The king should strengthen his rule, comfort his people, hold his borders firm, and seek sincere friendship with Annam.

sentences.zh: 其餘嫌細故，悉宜捐除。

translations.literal: Other resentments over minor matters should all be set aside.
translations.idiomatic: All lesser grudges should be dropped.

sentences.zh: 倘不能自強，專藉朝 廷發兵渡海，代王守國，古無是理。」

translations.literal: If he cannot strengthen himself but relies solely on the court sending troops across the sea to guard the state in the king's stead, there is no such principle in antiquity."
translations.idiomatic: If he cannot govern himself yet expects the court to send troops across the sea to hold his kingdom for him, there is no precedent for that."

sentences.zh: 帝如其言。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved their words.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 三年遣使謝恩。

translations.literal: In the third year envoys were sent to give thanks for the grace received.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 envoys came to express thanks.

sentences.zh: 其國自殘破後， 民物蕭條，貢使漸稀。

translations.literal: Since their state was devastated, people and goods grew desolate, and tribute envoys gradually became fewer.
translations.idiomatic: After the devastation, people and goods dwindled, and tributary missions grew ever scarcer.

sentences.zh: 十二，年遣使奏：「本國新州港之地，仍為安南侵奪，患方未息。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year envoys memorialized: "The lands of Xinzhou Harbor in our state are still being seized by Annam, and the trouble has not yet ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 envoys reported: "Annam still seizes our lands at Xinzhou Harbor, and our troubles continue.

sentences.zh: 臣年已老， 請及臣未死，命長子沙古卜洛襲封，庶他日可保國土。」

translations.literal: I am already old; I beg that before I die my eldest son Sagobalo be ordered to succeed to the investiture, so that in days to come the territory of the state may be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: I am old; before I die I ask that my eldest son Sagobalo be invested as heir, so that our lands may yet be preserved."

sentences.zh: 廷議：「安南為占城患， 已非一日。

translations.literal: The court deliberated: "Annam's harm to Champa is not of a single day.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated: "Annam's oppression of Champa is nothing new.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘗因占城之醞，累降璽書，曲垂誨諭。

translations.literal: The court has repeatedly, because of Champa's grievances, sent down imperial letters, bending its grace to instruct and counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Again and again, at Champa's plea, the court has sent imperial letters with patient counsel.

sentences.zh: 安南前後奏報，皆言祗承朝 命，土地人民，悉已退還。

translations.literal: Annam's memorials before and after have all said that it reverently obeys the court's command and that lands and people have all been returned.
translations.idiomatic: Annam has repeatedly reported that it obeyed the court's orders and returned all lands and people.

sentences.zh: 然安南辨釋之語方至，而占城控訴之詞又聞，恐真有不 獲已之情。

translations.literal: Yet just as Annam's explanations arrive, Champa's petitions of complaint are heard again; I fear there may truly be circumstances in which neither side can help itself.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as soon as Annam's explanations arrive, Champa's complaints follow—there may truly be circumstances neither side can escape.

sentences.zh: 宜仍令守臣切諭安南，毋貪人土地，自貽禍殃，否則議遣偏師往問其罪。

translations.literal: Frontier officials should still be ordered to urgently instruct Annam not to covet others' lands and bring disaster upon itself; otherwise the dispatch of a detachment to demand an accounting of its crimes should be considered.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials should again warn Annam not to seize others' territory and invite disaster—or else consider sending troops to call it to account.

sentences.zh: 至占城王長子，無父在襲封之理。

translations.literal: As for the eldest son of the king of Champa, there is no principle of succeeding to investiture while the father still lives.
translations.idiomatic: As for the king's eldest son, there is no precedent for investiture while his father still lives.

sentences.zh: 請令先立為世子攝國事，俟他日當襲位時，如例 請封。」

translations.literal: It is requested that he first be established as heir apparent to administer state affairs, and when the day comes that he should succeed, that investiture be requested according to precedent."
translations.idiomatic: He should be named heir apparent to govern in the meantime and seek formal investiture only when succession falls due."

sentences.zh: 帝報允。

translations.literal: The Emperor replied approvingly.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 尋遣王孫沙不登古魯來貢。

translations.literal: Soon after, the king's grandson Sabudenggulu was sent to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the king's grandson Sabudenggulu arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十八年，古來卒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Kulai died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 Kulai died.

sentences.zh: 子沙古卜洛遣使來貢，不告父喪，但乞命大臣往其國，仍以 新州港諸地封之。

translations.literal: His son Sagobalo sent envoys to offer tribute, without reporting his father's death, but begging that great ministers be sent to his country and that the lands around Xinzhou Harbor be invested to him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sagobalo sent tribute without announcing his father's death, asking only that high ministers be sent to invest him and restore the Xinzhou Harbor territories.

sentences.zh: 別有佔奪方輿之奏，微及父卒事。

translations.literal: Separately there was a memorial on seized territory that lightly touched on his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: A separate memorial on seized territory briefly mentioned his father's death.

sentences.zh: 給事中任良弼等言：「占城前 因國土削弱，假貢乞封，仰仗天威，詟伏鄰國。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Ren Liangbi and others said: "Champa, because its territory had earlier been weakened, used tribute to beg investiture, relying on heavenly might to awe neighboring states into submission.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Ren Liangbi argued: "Champa, weakened by war, has used tribute missions to seek investiture, counting on imperial prestige to intimidate its neighbors.

sentences.zh: 其實國王之立不立，不繫朝廷之封 不封也。

translations.literal: In truth whether a king is established or not does not depend on whether the court invests him or not.
translations.idiomatic: In truth a king's throne does not depend on whether the court grants investiture.

sentences.zh: 今稱古來已歿，虛實難知。

translations.literal: Now it is said Kulai is already dead—the truth is hard to know.
translations.idiomatic: Now they claim Kulai is dead; we cannot verify that.

sentences.zh: 萬一我使至彼，古來尚存，將遂封其子乎？

translations.literal: If by chance our envoy reaches there while Kulai still lives, shall we then invest his son?
translations.idiomatic: If our envoy arrives and Kulai is still alive, do we invest the son anyway?

sentences.zh: 抑 義不可而已乎？

translations.literal: Or would righteousness forbid it and stop there?
translations.idiomatic: Or would propriety forbid it?

sentences.zh: 迫脅之間，事極難處。

translations.literal: Between coercion and constraint, the matter is extremely hard to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Caught in such a bind, the matter would be nearly impossible to manage.

sentences.zh: 如往時科臣林霄之使滿剌加，不肯北面屈膝， 幽餓而死，迄不能問其罪。

translations.literal: As when the censorial official Lin Xiao was sent to Malacca in former times—the ruler refused to face north and bow; Lin was imprisoned and starved to death, and to the end his wrongdoing could not be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Recall Commissioner Lin Xiao's mission to Malacca: the ruler refused to bow north, Lin was imprisoned and starved to death, and his killers were never punished.

sentences.zh: 君命國威，不可不慎。

translations.literal: The sovereign's command and the state's majesty cannot be treated carelessly.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial authority must be handled with the utmost care.

sentences.zh: 大都海外諸蕃，無事則廢朝貢而 自立，有事則假朝貢而請封。

translations.literal: For the most part, the foreign states beyond the sea, when all is well, abandon tribute and set themselves up independently; when trouble arises, they use tribute to request investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Overseas states generally neglect tribute when at peace and install themselves independently, then use tribute to request investiture when in trouble.

sentences.zh: 今者貢使之來，豈急於求封，不過欲復安南之侵地， 還粵東之逃人耳。

translations.literal: The coming of tribute envoys this time—are they urgently seeking investiture? It is nothing more than wishing to recover Annam's encroached lands and return fugitives from eastern Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: This tribute mission is scarcely about investiture; they chiefly want Annam's seized lands back and fugitives returned from Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 夫安南侵地，璽書屢諭歸還，佔據如故。

translations.literal: As for Annam's encroached lands, imperial letters have repeatedly instructed their return, yet occupation continues as before.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial letters have repeatedly ordered Annam to return the seized lands; it still holds them.

sentences.zh: 今若再諭，彼將玩視之， 天威褻矣。

translations.literal: If we instruct again now, they will treat it lightly and heavenly majesty will be profaned.
translations.idiomatic: Further edicts will only be ignored—and imperial dignity diminished.

sentences.zh: 倘我使往封占城，羈留不遣，求為處分，朝廷將何以應？

translations.literal: If our envoy goes to invest Champa and is detained and not sent back, seeking settlement from the court—how will the court respond?
translations.idiomatic: If we send an envoy to invest Champa and he is detained, what can the court do?

sentences.zh: 又或拘我使者， 令索逃人，是以天朝之貴臣，質於海外之蠻邦。

translations.literal: Or again they may detain our envoy and demand fugitives in exchange—thus making a precious minister of the heavenly court a hostage in a barbarian state beyond the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Or they may hold our envoy hostage to demand fugitives—making a minister of the court a captive in a foreign land.

sentences.zh: 宜如往年古來就封廣東事，令其領 敕歸國，於計為便。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow the precedent of Kulai's investiture in Guangdong in former years and have the envoys receive the edict and return to their country; in planning terms this is convenient."
translations.idiomatic: The prudent course is the precedent of Kulai's Guangdong investiture: let the envoy carry the edict home."

sentences.zh: 禮部亦以古來存亡未明，請令廣東守臣移文占城勘報，從之， 既而封事久不行。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites also, because Kulai's survival was unclear, requested that Guangdong frontier officials send documents to Champa to investigate and report; the request was approved, but investiture was long delayed and never carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites too, uncertain whether Kulai lived, asked Guangdong officials to inquire in Champa; this was approved, but investiture was never completed.

sentences.zh: 正德五年，沙古卜洛遣叔父沙系把麻入貢，因請封。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengde Sagobalo sent his paternal uncle Saxibama to enter with tribute and thereby request investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde year 5 Sagobalo sent his uncle Saxibama with tribute to seek investiture.

sentences.zh: 命給事中李貫、行人劉廷 瑞往。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Li Guan and Commissioner Liu Tingrui were ordered to go.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Li Guan and Commissioner Liu Tingrui were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 貫抵廣東憚行，請如往年古來故事，令其使臣領封。

translations.literal: When Li Guan reached Guangdong he feared the journey and requested that, following the precedent of Kulai in former years, the envoys be allowed to receive investiture there.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guan reached Guangdong but feared the voyage and asked, as with Kulai before, that the envoys carry investiture home from there.

sentences.zh: 廷議：「遣官已二年， 今若中止，非興滅繼絕義。

translations.literal: Court deliberation: "Officials have already been dispatched for two years; if we stop now, that is not the principle of restoring extinguished states and continuing severed lineages.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated: "If envoys had already been preparing for two years, to abandon the mission now would betray the duty to restore a fallen state and preserve its royal line.

sentences.zh: 倘其使不願領封，或領歸而受非其人，重起事端，益傷 國體，宜令貫等亟往。」

translations.literal: If their envoys are unwilling to receive investiture, or receive it and invest one who is not the right person, trouble will arise anew, further harming national dignity—it is fitting to order Guan and the others to go at once."
translations.idiomatic: If the envoys refuse investiture, or invest the wrong man on their return, new troubles would further damage imperial dignity. Guan and his party should proceed without delay."

sentences.zh: 貫終憚行，以乏通事、火長為詞。

translations.literal: Guan still feared the journey, using the lack of interpreters and pilots as his excuse.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guan still refused to go, citing the lack of interpreters and ship pilots.

sentences.zh: 廷議令廣東守臣採訪其 人，如終不得，則如舊例行。

translations.literal: The court ordered Guangdong frontier officials to seek out such persons; if they ultimately could not be found, then follow the old precedent as before.
translations.idiomatic: The court told Guangdong officials to find suitable men; if none could be found, the old Guangdong investiture precedent would apply.

sentences.zh: 貫復設詞言：「臣奉命五載，似憚風波之險，殊不知 占城自古來被逐後，竄居赤崁邦都郎，國非舊疆，勢不可往。

translations.literal: Guan again made excuses, saying: "Your servant has received the commission for five years, as if fearing the perils of wind and waves—but he does not know that after Kulai of Champa was driven out, he lurks at Ak Bang Du Lang; the country is not its former territory, and in circumstance one cannot go.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guan offered new excuses: "He had held the commission for five years and seemed to fear the sea—but Kulai, driven from Champa, lurked at Ak Bang Du Lang; the realm was no longer where it had been, and the journey was impracticable.

sentences.zh: 況古來乃前王齋亞麻 弗菴之頭目，殺王而奪其位。

translations.literal: Moreover, Kulai was originally a subordinate of the former king Jayavarman; he killed the king and seized the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, Kulai had been a subordinate of King Jayavarman; he murdered his lord and usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 王有三子，其一尚存，義又不可。

translations.literal: The king had three sons, and one still survives—in righteousness this too is impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: The king had three sons, and one still lives—investiture would also be unjust.

sentences.zh: 律以《春秋》之法， 雖不興問罪之師，亦必絕朝貢之使。

translations.literal: Judged by the methods of the Spring and Autumn Annals, even if one does not raise an army to demand punishment, one must still cut off tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: By Spring and Autumn standards, even without sending a punitive expedition, tribute relations with a usurper must be severed.

sentences.zh: 奈何又為採訪之議，徒延歲月，於事無益。」

translations.literal: Why then advance again the proposal to investigate and seek persons—it only prolongs the months and years, benefiting the matter in nothing."
translations.idiomatic: To pursue investigators instead merely wastes time and accomplishes nothing."

sentences.zh: 廣東巡按丁楷亦附會具奏，廷議從之。

translations.literal: Surveillance Commissioner Ding Kai of Guangdong also echoed this in a memorial, and the court deliberation accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong Surveillance Commissioner Ding Kai submitted a supporting memorial, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十年令其使臣齎敕往，自是遂為故事，其國 貢使亦不常至。

translations.literal: In the tenth year envoys were ordered to carry the edict there; from this it became established practice, and tribute envoys from that country also no longer came regularly.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 10 envoys were sent to carry the investiture edict home—a practice thereafter fixed. Tribute missions from Champa became sporadic.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十二年遣王叔沙不登古魯來貢，訴數為安南侵擾，道阻難歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jiajing the king's uncle Sabudeng Guru was sent to offer tribute, complaining of repeated harassment by Annam and that the route was blocked and return difficult.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 22 the king's uncle Sabudeng Guru came with tribute, reporting repeated Annamite incursions and blocked routes that made return home impossible.

sentences.zh: 乞遣官護 送還國，報可。

translations.literal: He begged that officials be dispatched to escort him back to his country; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for escorts home; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 其國無霜雪，四時皆似夏，草木常青。

translations.literal: That country knows no frost or snow; the four seasons are all like summer, and plants and trees stay ever green.
translations.idiomatic: Champa knows neither frost nor snow; all four seasons feel like summer, and vegetation stays green year-round.

sentences.zh: 民以漁為業，無二麥，力穡者少，故收 獲薄。

translations.literal: The people make their living by fishing; there is no double-crop grain, and few labor at tillage, so harvests are meager.
translations.idiomatic: The people live by fishing; with no winter wheat and few who farm diligently, harvests are poor.

sentences.zh: 國人皆食檳榔，終日不離口。

translations.literal: All the people of the country eat betel nut and never leave it from their mouths all day.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone chews betel nut and keeps it in the mouth from dawn to dusk.

sentences.zh: 不解朔望，但以月生為初，月晦為盡，不置閏。

translations.literal: They do not understand new moon and full moon; they take the moon's waxing as beginning and waning as end, and establish no intercalary months.
translations.idiomatic: They do not reckon by new and full moons, marking only the moon's waxing as a month's start and its waning as its end, with no intercalary months.

sentences.zh: 分晝夜為十更，非日中不起，非夜分不臥，見月則飲酒、歌舞為樂。

translations.literal: Day and night are divided into ten watches; they do not rise before midday or sleep before midnight; when they see the moon they drink wine and sing and dance for pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: They divide day and night into ten watches, rise no earlier than noon, sleep no earlier than midnight, and whenever the moon appears they drink, sing, and dance for joy.

sentences.zh: 無紙筆，用羊 皮槌薄燻黑，削細竹蘸白灰為字，狀若蚯蚓。

translations.literal: They have no paper or brush; they beat sheepskin thin, smoke it black, shave fine bamboo, dip it in white ash to make characters shaped like earthworms.
translations.idiomatic: Without paper or brushes, they beat sheepskin thin, smoke it black, and write with fine bamboo dipped in white ash—characters wriggling like earthworms.

sentences.zh: 有城郭甲兵，人性狠而狡，貿易多不 平。

translations.literal: They have walled cities, armor, and weapons; human nature is fierce and cunning, and in trade many dealings are unfair.
translations.idiomatic: They have walled towns and armed forces; the people are fierce and cunning, and trade is often dishonest.
